The trajectory of a material point and the trajectory of a light ray coincide under a certain correspondence between the potential energy and the spatially varying refractive index of the medium. This fact was theoretically discovered by the outstanding Irish mathematician and physicist W. R. Hamilton in {#0} and in our century influenced the establishment of the connection between wave optics and wave (quantum) mechanics.
